text: Appeal of Order to Comply (March 29, 2019) for 82 Warren Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated March 29, 2019, regarding the property located at 82 Warren Road, Exterior and Parking Garage, Folder No. 19 130823 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 27, 2019 for Items 1-3 and granted an extension of time to June 1, 2020 for Items 4-13 listed in Schedule "A".
